purpose: Task 1, like Task 3 before experiment 75, is trained with a single seed while Task 2 uses three. Test whether seed averaging improves the Task 1 reconstruction+retrieval score under the frozen public protocol.
scope: Only test/03_task1_reconstruction/85_task1_multiseed. src/ and src/final_config.json are read-only.

protocol.split: test/evaluate_final.py public_protocol, task1, split seed 42, RNG123 permutation of the 275 validation pictures: first 16 tune, next 48 unused, remaining 211 heldout
protocol.training: src.final.train_task with the v5 config unchanged except task1.seeds
protocol.prediction: src.final.predict_task: mean of per-seed DCT32 predictions, dct_decode, directional2 retrieval against the NotoSansSC 6763-glyph bank
protocol.metric: official OCF on final predictions, per mouse and per block; no Hungarian step exists in Task 1, so no assignment ambiguity

recorded_base.requirement: the base arm must reproduce both within 1e-4 or the experiment is void

pass_rule.advance: heldout OCF higher than base for BOTH mice, tune OCF not lower than base minus 0.02, and at least 5 of 8 mouse x picture-holdout blocks non-negative versus base
pass_rule.no_further_sweeps: no seed count beyond three is tried in this experiment

prohibited: tuning epochs or seeds on the heldout pictures
